definitions.consecutive_identical_command_ge3: At least three consecutive identical executed command strings; does not establish a harmful loop.
definitions.consecutive_same_observation_and_map: At least one adjacent pair of steps with identical observable text and available-action list; excludes prior history and is not full prompt equality.
definitions.diagnostic_cause: UNKNOWN unless separately supported; outcome and repeated patterns are descriptive only.

limitations: Selection is outcome-informed, post-hoc and not a randomized or confirmatory analysis.
Single analyst; full independent case review pending.
No inference that observed repetition caused failure or that training source caused a difference.
Remainder of 82-task cohort is not the denominator for selected-case summaries.
